issue.title: Retire typed_launch_units
issue.description: Beta gate for typed launch units, %if, and %proc.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Mixed Agent/Proc launches, skipped admission, recovery, and both editor surfaces have operational evidence.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Explicit %if and %proc uses are rejected with a precise error, hidden from completion, and never forwarded to a model; existing all-agent launches keep their current path.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Typed mixed Agent and Proc launch units plus %if and %proc parse and execute as one coherent feature.
